# Blueshore Technologies — LLM Context & Brand Overview

> Official structured metadata and capabilities guide for AI search engines, agents, and generative search tools.

## Organization & Entity Info
- Name: Blueshore Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 2020
- Founders & Directors: Abhishek Kashyap, Ashish Kushwaha
- Headquarters: Delhi NCR, India
- Website: https://www.blueshoretech.com
- Contact Email: info@blueshoretech.com
- Phone: +91-99907-12555

## Core Service Pillars
1. Custom Software & B2B Web Applications: Bespoke Django/React codebases, secure client portals, and high-throughput SQL/NoSQL databases.
2. AI & Intelligent Automation Services: RAG systems, private LLM fine-tuning, LangChain integrations, vector databases, and agentic workflows.
3. Cloud Architecture & Zero-Trust DevOps: AWS/Azure/GCP orchestration, Kubernetes clusters, Terraform IaC, and SOC 2 security compliance.
4. Generative Engine & AI Citation Optimization (GEO/AEO): Structuring content for high-authority citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google Gemini.
5. Performance Marketing & B2B Lead Generation: High-intent PPC management, ABM LinkedIn campaigns, and negative keyword optimization.
